screen: Subject Profile — Performance and Efforts Entry
description: Save performance and efforts entry from list (Remarks screen, Figma 19230:57867). All entry data in request; response is save result only.

example_request.overallRemarks: Shows good listening skills in class.

notes.list: GET subject-profile/19230-57868--performance-efforts-list.json to load studentCard, criteria[] rows, and Overall Remarks form.
notes.save: POST full request body on Save or Save and Next — context fields + criteria[] (performance + efforts per row) + overallRemarks + selectedSuggestionIds.
notes.criterionOptions: performance and efforts id values from subject-profile/19230-58601--performance-efforts-criterion-options.json.
notes.saveAndNext: After successful POST, client navigates to studentCard.nextStudentId from list response.
notes.suggestions: selectedSuggestionIds from student-profile/19230-57627--remarks-suggestions-list.json when Suggestions is used.
